//: Offline seed mode is no longer something a launch config arranges — it is what the application does when none of the six Supabase variables is set, which is the state `.env.local` is in. `configurationMode()` in src/lib/supabase/config.ts returns 'offline' only when *all six* are absent; a half-configured boundary throws rather than degrading. So there is nothing left for a config to blank. The three entries that used to live here each cleared NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to force a seed fallback; that variable was retired with the control/content split and no code reads it any more, which made all three configs identical to plain `npm run dev` while claiming otherwise.

configurations.//: The only dev config. While the six Supabase variables are absent this is the full offline preview: recipes and articles come from the repository seed, uploads land in public/lab/ and data/lab-articles.dev.json (both gitignored), and /blog/admin is open with no login — requireAdmin() hands out the dev@localhost super-admin whenever hasControlConfig() is false and NODE_ENV is development. Port 3000 is also the OAuth callback origin, which matters again as soon as the control plane is configured. Next 16 takes a per-directory lock and refuses a second `next dev` in this tree, so there is one server here, not a choice of three.
configurations.name: alpha-colorlab
